section:
1/1/2015Enacted by Chapter 315, 2014 General Session2014Definitions.As used in this part: "Tax credit" means a nonrefundable tax credit listed on a tax return. "Tax return" means:
a corporate return as defined in Section 59-7-101 filed in accordance with this chapter; or a tax return filed in accordance with Chapter 8, Gross Receipts Tax on Certain Corporations Not Required to Pay Corporate Franchise or Income Tax Act.
